system_description.narrative_title: US–China tech-industrial rivalry reshaping supply chains ahead of Trump–Xi summit
system_description.narrative_summary: News converges on a single narrative: diplomatic engagement between the US and China (centered on the upcoming Trump–Xi interactions) is driving and attempting to manage an intensifying techno-economic competition over semiconductors, AI, and autos. The system is open — it consists of states, firms, technologies, capital flows and policy instruments that interact, exchange information, and adapt (investment, export limits, subsidies, joint ventures), producing feedbacks such as reshoring, allied coordination, and trade friction. The summit and related meetings act as short-term catalysts inside a longer-running strategic realignment of supply chains and governance frameworks.
system_description.scope: State actors (US, China, EU, Japan), corporations (chipmakers, automakers, AI firms), technologies (semiconductors, memory, AI models, EV/hybrid platforms, batteries), policy tools (export controls, tariffs, industrial subsidies, trade diplomacy), capital and manufacturing location decisions, and near-term diplomatic events tied to the Trump–Xi summit.
system_description.super_system: The global geopolitical-economic order: great-power rivalry shaping international trade, technology governance, security norms, and global supply chains.
adjacent_subsystems: Global semiconductor manufacturing and supply chains
Automotive industry transition (EVs, hybrids) and trade rules
AI governance and security (dual-use risks, cyber-espionage)
Regional industrial policy (EU, Japan, US allied coordination)

variables.name: Technological innovation rate
variables.description: The pace at which new capabilities, process improvements, and product innovations in relevant technologies (e.g., semiconductors, AI, batteries) are developed and deployed.

variables.name: Advanced chip production capacity
variables.description: The aggregate manufacturing capacity for leading-edge semiconductor nodes and advanced memory measured as producible wafers or equivalent units over time.

variables.name: Semiconductor supply concentration
variables.description: The degree to which production, critical inputs, and suppliers for semiconductor components are concentrated across regions or single-source nodes.

variables.name: Capital investment flow to tech manufacturing
variables.description: The rate and direction of financial resources deployed into manufacturing capacity, fabs, tooling, and related infrastructure for high-tech production.

variables.name: Export control stringency
variables.description: The strictness and scope of regulatory limits on cross-border transfers of technologies, equipment, and components relevant to strategic industries.

variables.name: Tariff and trade barrier level
variables.description: The prevailing level of tariffs, quotas, and non-tariff measures that impede or raise the cost of cross-border trade in tech goods and inputs.

variables.name: Allied policy coordination
variables.description: The extent and intensity of coordinated policy actions among like-minded actors on trade, export limits, investment screening, and standards for technology governance.

variables.name: Reshoring and nearshoring rate
variables.description: The rate at which manufacturing capacity, production lines, and supply-chain stages are relocated closer to consumer or policymaker jurisdictions.

variables.name: Supply-chain resilience
variables.description: The ability of supply networks to absorb, adapt to, and recover from disruptions while maintaining production of critical components.

variables.name: Market concentration in critical components
variables.description: The market share distribution among suppliers of key inputs (e.g., memory, wafers, advanced packaging) indicating monopolistic or oligopolistic structures.

variables.name: Global demand pressure for tech products
variables.description: The aggregate demand intensity for semiconductors, AI-enabled systems, electric vehicles, and related products that drives capacity and investment decisions.

variables.name: R&D spending flow
variables.description: The rate of expenditure on research and development focused on foundational and applied advances in semiconductors, AI, batteries, and related technologies.

variables.name: Talent mobility rate
variables.description: The rate of movement, hiring, and skill flow of engineers, researchers, and technical specialists across firms and regions within the tech ecosystem.

variables.name: Cybersecurity threat level
variables.description: The prevalence and severity of cyber intrusions, intellectual property theft, and information-security vulnerabilities affecting tech supply chains and R&D.

variables.name: Strategic mistrust level
variables.description: The degree of reciprocal strategic suspicion among major actors regarding technology intentions, dual-use risks, and long-term security implications.

variables.name: Policy uncertainty about tech governance
variables.description: The level of ambiguity and unpredictability in future policy choices, regulatory frameworks, and enforcement that affect investment and cooperation in tech sectors.

catalysts.title: Trump–Xi summit in Washington
catalysts.description: High-level state visit between US and Chinese leaders expected next week; may set tone for trade, export controls, and investment cooperation.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'What will Trump and Xi discuss in Washington next week?'

catalysts.title: State dinner with tech and finance leaders
catalysts.description: High-profile state dinner where tech and bank CEOs (e.g., Nvidia, JPMorgan, Citigroup) will attend and may announce deals or partnerships.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Nvidia CEO Huang attending Trump's state dinner for China's Xi'; 'JPMorgan, Citigroup CEOs attending Trump's state dinner for China's Xi'.

catalysts.title: Push to bar Chinese automakers from U.S. market
catalysts.description: U.S. auto industry urging the administration to block Chinese automakers from U.S. market access ahead of Xi visit, pressuring trade policy decisions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Auto industry urges Trump to bar Chinese automakers in U.S. ahead of Xi visit'; 'Auto industry urges Trump to keep Chinese automakers out ahead of Xi meeting'.

catalysts.title: U.S.–Japan chip factory construction talks
catalysts.description: Ongoing negotiations to build semiconductor fabs under a $550bn investment framework, potentially accelerating onshore advanced manufacturing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Japan, US discussing chip factory construction as part of $550 billion investment talks'.

catalysts.title: SK Hynix–Intel U.S. memory manufacturing talks
catalysts.description: Reports of SK Hynix negotiating with Intel and Solidigm weighing a U.S. NAND memory factory, which could expand U.S. memory production capacity.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'EXCLUSIVE: SK Hynix in talks with Intel about deal to make memory chips in the US'; 'SK Hynix's Solidigm unit is weighing NAND memory chip factory in US'.

catalysts.title: CXMT flash-memory capacity push
catalysts.description: China's CXMT planning an expansion into flash memory amid global shortages, potentially altering market supply dynamics for memory components.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'EXCLUSIVE: China's CXMT eyes flash-memory push amid global shortage'; 'CXMT plans flash memory chip expansion'.

catalysts.title: Proposal for nuclear-style AI safeguards
catalysts.description: Security experts from the U.S. and China propose formal, high-assurance safeguard frameworks for AI risks, which could spur policy coordination or new regimes.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'US, China security experts propose nuclear-style safeguards for AI risks'; 'AI military risks spark concern'.

catalysts.title: EU asks China to limit hybrid car exports
catalysts.description: EU requests China voluntarily curb hybrid car exports to avert a trade row; could prompt trade negotiations or defensive measures.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'EU asks China to voluntarily limit hybrid car exports'; 'EU seeks China curbs on hybrid car exports to avert trade row'.

catalysts.title: US Treasury talks on AI and rare earths
catalysts.description: U.S. Treasury envoy Scott Bessent to meet China's He Lifeng to discuss AI and rare earths, potentially affecting export rules and supply assurances.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'US Treasury's Bessent will meet with China's He Lifeng this weekend'; 'Bessent plans to discuss AI and rare earths with China's He'.

catalysts.title: Chinese executives may join Xi's US visit
catalysts.description: Reports that BYD, CATL, Xiaomi executives may accompany Xi to the U.S., raising chances of investment announcements or cross-border partnerships.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'BYD, CATL, Xiaomi executives may join Xi's US visit, sources say'.
